items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: now, see, I had those kinds of bands and couldn't keep them together

ctx.x: Buster Bailey on clarinet and Dick Wellstood on piano and Cliff Leeman on drums and Willie Wayman on bass - who was on trombone?
Buster Bailey was on clarinet -- we can't think who was on trombone---
